cases.title: feat: EXP-V1-0004 documentation and context engineering standard
cases.body:
## Summary

- **EXP-V1-0004 (parent)**: Configurable context engineering for a project's technical documentation directory. Enforces structured docs with frontmatter-driven indexing — every `.md` file has YAML front matter, every directory has a `README.md` with auto-generated `## Index` tables. CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md context files per directory for AI agents. Root-level context files referencing documentation location. All configurable via `.apss/config.toml` with zero-config defaults.
- **EXP-V1-0004.ADR01 (substandard)**: Enforces Architecture Decision Records — `ADR-XXX-<name>.md` naming (3-5 digit numbers), required front matter (`name`, `description`, `status`), Fowler lifecycle (`proposed`/`accepted`/`deprecated`/`superseded`), keyword-based required ADRs, required `## Context/Decision/Consequences` headers, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md with backlinking guidance, dead ADR reference detection, and superseded/deprecated reference warnings.
- **CLI integration**: `aps run docs validate` and `aps run docs index` commands that run both parent and substandard, merging diagnostics. Central standard registry eliminates magic strings.

### Error codes

| Parent (DOC) | Substandard (ADR01) |
|---|---|
| MISSING_README | ADR01-001 Missing ADR directory |
| MISSING_CLAUDE_MD | ADR01-002 Invalid naming |
| MISSING_AGENTS_MD | ADR01-003 Missing front matter |
| MISSING_INDEX | ADR01-004 Required keyword not satisfied |
| STALE_INDEX | ADR01-005 Reserved |
| MISSING_ROOT_CLAUDE_MD | ADR01-006 Invalid naming regex |
| MISSING_ROOT_AGENTS_MD | ADR01-007 Missing context file |
| MISSING_DOCS_REFERENCE | ADR01-008 Context file lacks guidance |
| | ADR01-009 Dead ADR reference |
| | ADR01-010 Missing required header |
| | ADR01-011 Missing/invalid status |
| | ADR01-012 Superseded/deprecated reference |

### Key design decisions

- **ADR_STEM_PATTERN** as single source of truth for all ADR regex patterns (`ADR-\d{3,5}-[a-zA-Z0-9-]+`)
- ADR status follows Fowler lifecycle — ADRs are never revised, only superseded
- Parent spec focuses on general docs structure; ADR details live in substandard

### Test coverage

- 5 config unit tests (stem pattern, filename pattern, keyword pattern, metacharacter escaping)
- 12 parent integration tests (config, frontmatter, index, readme)
- 14 ADR unit tests (error codes, reference extraction, header matching, status validation, digit range)
- 28 ADR integration tests across 7 fixture scenarios

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo check --workspace` compiles
- [x] `cargo test -p documentation` — all pass
- [x] `cargo test -p documentation-adr` — all pass (14 unit + 28 integration)
- [x] `cargo clippy -p documentation -p documentation-adr -p aps-cli -- -D warnings` — clean
- [x] `cargo test -p aps-cli test_all_v1_standards_pass_validation` — self-validation passes
